development_corrections.reason: Regional outage reports cannot establish a dependency for an MCP upload with no supplied region.

baseline_limitations: Original baseline retains parsed responses, expected pause labels, per-case latency and exception class. Raw response text and specific validation categories were not recorded by that evaluator and cannot be reconstructed exactly.
qualification_v1_defect: Acquisition timestamps were fixed at zero, contradicting the fresh-evidence labels. The v1 run is diagnostic only. V2 uses raw AWS events and rebases acquisition time for each inference while retaining old publication/update timestamps.
